exists glow        && znap function _glow glow 'eval "$(glow completion zsh)"'
exists jj          && znap function _jj jj 'eval "$(jj util completion zsh)"'
exists maestral    && znap function _maestral maestral 'eval "$(maestral completion zsh)"'
exists rg          && znap function _rg rg 'eval "$(rg --generate=complete-zsh)"'
exists rustup      && znap function _rustup rustup 'eval "$(rustup completions zsh)"'
exists syncthing   && znap function _synthing synthing 'eval "$(synthing install-completions)"'
exists tree-sitter && znap function _tree-sitter tree-sitter 'eval "$(tree-sitter complete --shell zsh)"'

    znap fpath _rg "rg --generate=complete-zsh"
    znap compile $FUNCTION_DIR

if (( $+commands[thefuck] || $+commands[fuck] )); then
    znap function _fuck fuck 'eval $(thefuck --alias)'
    compdef _fuck fuck
